title: ExamOven Demo Exam 2026 - General - Rich Text - Tables
subject: General

questions.q:
Markdown tables are perfect for structured data. 

Based on the table below, which Fruit has the color 'Red'?

| Fruit  | Color  | Taste |
|:-------|:-------|:------|
| Apple  | Red    | Sweet |
| Banana | Yellow | Sweet |
| Lemon  | Yellow | Sour  |
questions.explain: Looking at the table row for **Apple**, the Color column clearly states **Red**.
